title: THE LOST PAD TITLE COLOURS ONLY ITS P1 OR P2 TAG
why: The critic scored the press a screen 2 with a P0: the whole title in amber sat beside the lime resume button, which the guide bans. Only the p1 or p2 tag keeps its player colour now; the words are the normal title colour.
now: On the lost pad screen only the p1 or p2 tag is coloured and the words are plain.
